is a fully molded table for dining rooms, dayrooms, and activity rooms in correctional and behavioral healthcare facilities. The top and the x-shaped base are rotationally molded from high impact “no break” polyethylene, and the rounded edge of the top adds safety and comfort.

The legs attach to the top with tamper-resistant screws. The table can be bolted to the floor through concealed pilot holes with the Cortech Sabre Mount System, or the legs can be filled with sand to weigh it down. It comes in 42” and 48” round sizes with a plain top or a game top, and it is rated for outdoor use.

These describe the molded X-base, not steel legs. I also left out "Stain resistant," which the Cortech spec sheet does not say.

Cortech Anchor 4-Seat Laminate Table with Molded Seats

is a fixed group seating table for dayrooms and dining areas in correctional and behavioral healthcare facilities. The laminate top and four molded seats are joined to a continuous welded steel frame that bolts to the floor, so the table and seats stay in place.

The seats are rotationally molded from high impact “no break” polyethylene and attach to the frame through molded-in threaded steel inserts and tamper-resistant hardware. The seamless laminate top has a rounded edge for safety and comfort. Choose a 42” round or 42”×42” square top, and order the ADA version with one fewer leg and seat for wheelchair access.

is a fully molded 42” round table for dining rooms, dayrooms, and activity rooms in correctional and behavioral healthcare facilities. The top and cylinder base are rotationally molded from high impact “no break” polyethylene, and the rounded edge of the top adds safety and comfort.

The base attaches to the top with tamper-resistant screws, and the table can be bolted to the floor through concealed pilot holes with the Cortech Sabre Mount System. An optional ballast door lets you add weight with sandbags. It comes with a plain top or a game top, pairs with the Cortech RazorBack Chair, and is rated for outdoor use.
